topic: the differential curve as a cross-corpus audit tool: fitting one learned surface over the union of two corpora (skills and self-docs) on a shared primitive basis, sparse-cell detection, Jaccard overlap as system coherence measurement, and skill land-grab detection

subtopics.scope: Building the shared 19-D primitive basis by concatenation with zero-padding: preserving each corpus's native primitive signal, why mixing is forbidden, and why 0 of 19 columns are dropped on the union.

coverage matrix gap analysis audit sparse coverage detection

variance threshold feature selection remove constant columns binary indicators
